name: 01-collection-pages
title: Retired Shell output collected in bounded pages (real Shell + Broker worker + MySQL 8.4.7 + fake OSS)
subtitle: PR #13087 head 6ff843bc (production code byte-identical to abad13c7, where the stack ran) · deletion-grace 0 s · gc-enabled=true
lines: ## Session A: two real Shell calls (200 MiB stdout + 47 MiB stderr, then 3 MiB) -> 2 publications; Session B (not retired): 4 MiB
== decoys planted by the rig: <A pub prefix>/zz-decoy-outside-catalog  and  <A pub prefix>-sibling/x
## 5c284e22 (252 catalog rows, 249 OSS objects) after retirement
== t       state      claim  cursor after confirm     held bytes      OSS objects under the prefix
>> +1.2s   DELETING   g1     segment:stdout:141       259,312,090     153   page 1 = 100 rows
>> +2.5s   DELETING   g2     segment:stdout:52        259,312,090      53   page 2 = 100 rows
++ +3.5s   COLLECTED  g3     terminal                           0       1   page 3 = 52 rows; only the decoy is left
## Fake-OSS ledger and SQL after both publications of A are COLLECTED
++ catalog OSS keys 255 · DELETE requests 255 · distinct 255 · keys outside the catalog 0 · all 204-removed
++ same-prefix decoy and sibling-prefix decoy survive; Session B stays PINNED with its 5 objects
++ released_held_bytes = collected_bytes = 262,761,401 · tenant held 266,965,521 -> 4,204,120 (exactly Session B)
++ inline cleared: the 2 tool-result manifest copies only; 33 other inline resources (messages, checkpoints, turn results) kept
== GetBucketVersioning during collection: 259 = 255 per object + 4 per page
note: Pagination is 100/100/52, held quota stays at its full value until the final page confirms, and nothing outside the SQL catalog is deleted. Retirement itself had to be driven through a rig seam: the public DELETE refuses Workspace Sessions (409 workspace_unavailable), see the report.

name: 02-faults-and-takeover
title: Faults on the real stack: lost reply, SIGKILL mid-page, SQL confirmation failure, competing JVMs
subtitle: Same rig · each row is one retired real publication · times are relative to retirement
lines: ## Lost DELETE reply (3rd key deleted, reply dropped)
+1.9s DELETING collection_retry, held kept · WARN with com.aliyun.oss.ClientException stack
++ +62.2s retry g2 repeats the same exact keys: 3 x 204-missing + 6 x 204-removed -> COLLECTED
## SIGKILL of the JVM while its 50th DELETE is in flight (116 objects)
old owner removed 49; replacement JVM up at ~+8.5s, waits for the 60 s claim
++ +61.8s g2 replays the page (49 x 204-missing + 67 x 204-removed) -> +63.2s COLLECTED g3 · released 121,651,334 once
== the dead JVM's DELETE landed at +435.7s -> 204-missing; 0 keys outside the catalog
## SQL confirmation failure (journal head row locked by another session, lock wait 3 s)
CannotAcquireLockException -> rollback; during the failure 5 inline objects + manifest copy and held quota are kept
++ +70.5s retry repeats the 9 keys (204-missing) -> COLLECTED; inline copies cleared only then
## Two JVMs on one database
!! hung DELETE: the OSS SDK socket timeout (50 s) fires before the 60 s claim, so A defers itself; B claims at +112 s
++ A frozen with SIGSTOP for ~63 s: first SQL after SIGCONT is the renew -> affected=0 -> A stops
++ A's confirm held 75 s in a SQL relay while B collects (g2): A's FOR UPDATE sees COLLECTED -> COMMIT with no writes,
++   its deferral UPDATE affected=0, row and released_held_bytes unchanged
note: Retries repeat the same exact keys, quota stays held until a confirmation under a live claim, and a stale JVM can neither renew nor confirm. Every delete count above is from the OSS ledger; every SQL outcome is from MySQL itself.

name: 03-fail-closed-and-gating
title: Fail closed, fairness, disabled GC, legacy rows and upgrades
subtitle: Same rig · O4-1 base arm = jar from 3ee43046 · main arm = jar from 93efe355 (merge-base)
lines: ## Persistent 403 on publication P1, healthy P2 retired right after it
++ P2 COLLECTED at +2.5s while P1 fails
!! P1 retried at +1s, +62s, +122s: DELETING collection_retry, 8,406,850 held bytes kept, WARN AccessDenied each time
== after the fault was cleared P1 was collected (g6): nothing releases it while the key stays denied
## Bucket versioning switched on after the server started
++ Enabled and then Suspended: 0 DELETE requests, IllegalStateException 'cannot enforce immutable objects'
## gc-enabled=false
++ 75 s after retirement still RETIRING, 0 DELETEs; observer logs sample=1 eligible_bytes=6309500
## Before: O4-1 base jar with gc-enabled=true
-- retired publication stays RETIRING; its 7 objects (6,303,801 B) and quota stay; no gc_* columns
++ same database restarted on the PR jar: V28 applied in 0.37 s, the publication COLLECTED on the first tick
## Legacy row written by the main jar, then V27+V28 applied by the PR jar
++ write_evidence=0 -> blocker legacy_write_evidence_missing, kept; a publication written after the upgrade in the same DB collected
note: All gates behave as described. The amber lines are the acknowledged R1-12 policy gap: a key that stays denied holds its publication and full quota forever, retried every 60 s.

name: 04-blocked-candidates
title: Blocked candidates use up the one-per-second claim slot (head vs candidate patch)
subtitle: 151 real publications · deletion-grace 120 s · E (1 publication) retired at t0, B (3 Sessions x 50 Shell calls) at t0+60 s
lines: ## head 6ff843bc (claim(): LIMIT 1, a blocked candidate is pushed 60 s and the tick ends)
E eligible at +120.9s
-- E collected at +216.1s  ->  95.2 s after it became eligible
-- blocked re-evaluations per minute: 57, 59 (one per tick, each takes the tenant row FOR UPDATE)
!! smoke run, grace 5 s: collected at +62 s, because the first evaluation inside grace pushed gc_next_at by 60 s
## candidate (+49/-33): grace blocker -> gc_next_at = retired_at + grace; up to 32 candidates per tick
E eligible at +120.3s
++ E collected at +121.2s  ->  0.96 s after it became eligible
++ blocked evaluations: 151 in total, exactly one per publication
++ 42 collector/retention/scheduling/adapter tests pass, Checkstyle 0
## Projection with the default 24 h grace (head)
!! every retired publication is re-evaluated ~1440 times while in grace
!! more than ~60 publications in grace per instance saturates the collector; eligible ones then wait ~N seconds
note: Not a safety problem and GC is off by default, but it is a throughput ceiling the O4-3 capacity gate should know about before GC is enabled.

name: 05-real-oss
title: Real Aliyun OSS: temporary private bucket in cn-hangzhou (created for this run, deleted afterwards)
subtitle: Same rig with the production AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore pointed at the real endpoint · bucket name redacted
lines: ## 101 MiB Shell publication: 107 catalog rows, 102 real OSS objects
++ page 1 (100 rows) took 5.5 s (~55 ms per object: renew + GetBucketVersioning + DeleteObject); COLLECTED at +7.8 s
++ ListObjects on its prefix afterwards: 0 objects; the live Session's 3 objects kept
## 8 MiB publication with two decoys planted next to it
++ 11 catalog objects deleted; same-prefix decoy and sibling-prefix decoy kept (bucket 16 -> 5 objects)
## Idempotent replay on real OSS
++ DeleteObject on a key that never existed -> HTTP 204 (405 ms), so repeating keys after a lost reply is safe
## Versioning enabled on the real bucket after the server started
++ collection_retry, 0 objects deleted, IllegalStateException
== cleanup: 9 object versions and the bucket deleted; a later request answered NoSuchBucket
note: The real adapter deletes only catalog keys and fails closed on versioning. Throughput on this link: about 15 objects per second including the 1 s tick delay.

name: 06-mutation
title: Mutation matrix on ToolPublicationCollector / AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore
subtitle: 41 unit tests (collector 24 incl. inherited, retention 13, adapter 4) · control green · one mutant at a time in a separate worktree
lines: ## killed 12/23
++ M1 eligibility recheck skipped · M5 quota released after page 1 · M6 probe never completes · M7 page ignores cursor
++ M8 no deferral · M9 deferral without delay · M11 resource cleanup skipped · M14 held not zeroed · M15 object inline kept
++ M20 tick lets the exception escape · M23 gc-enabled ignored · M24 adapter delete without its versioning check
## survived
-- M12 Session resource cleanup widened to the whole Session (would clear messages, checkpoints, turn results)
!! M13 used bytes not zeroed (held still zeroed, so capacity is unaffected)
== M2/M3/M4, M2+M3+M4 confirm owner/generation/cursor fences · M17/M18, M17+M18 renew owner/generation fences
==   (the state and expiry conjuncts carry the existing tests; a stale confirm can only follow a fully deleted page)
== M16/M21 in-transaction rechecks that only matter in a race · M19 page-level versioning check · M22 lease cleanup
## candidate test +29 lines (collectionClearsOnlyThePublicationsSessionResources)
++ passes on head (42/42), kills M12 and M13, Checkstyle 0
note: M12 is the one worth pinning: on the real stack the collector cleared only the 2 manifest copies and kept 33 other inline resources, but no test would notice if that WHERE clause widened.
